newsitem.title: USA: Norwood Promotional sees Q4 EPS $0.20-0.22.
newsitem.headline: Norwood Promotional sees Q4 EPS $0.20-0.22.

text.p: Norwood Promotional Products Inc said on Wednesday it expects its fourth quarter earnings to be about $0.20 to $0.22 per share.
This will result in earnings of about $1.01 to $1.03 per share, before a non-recurring charge, for the fiscal year ending August 31, 1996, the company said.

It said it expects to take an after-tax charge of about $950,000, or $0.19 per share, against fiscal 1996 earnings. The charge is primarily related to realignments and organizational changes at its Designer Line, Ocean Specialty and ArtMold Products businesses.
Including this charge, the company said it expects fiscal 1996 earnings to be about $0.82 to $0.84 per share.
According to First Call mean estimates, analysts' expectations for fourth quarter earnings are $0.27 per share, and $1.06 per share for the fiscal year.
